headline: Türkiye to Unveil National Energy 2040 Strategy Envisioning $100 Billion Investment
summary: Türkiye plans to launch its National Energy 2040 framework next week in Istanbul, outlining strategic energy transition initiatives and $100 billion in targeted capital expenditure.
why: Türkiye is an energy transit hub connecting Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, seeking to expand renewables and nuclear power capacity.
